test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A girl walking at a speed of 9 km/h crosses a bridge in 45 minutes. Find the length of the bridge in metres.
solution:
**Given:**

A girl walking at a speed of 9 km/h crosses a bridge in 45 minutes.

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

Time = 45 minutes = 45/60 hours = 0.75 hours

Speed = 9 km/h

Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = 9 km/h × 0.75 hours

⇒ Distance = 6.75 km

⇒ Distance in metres = 6.75 km × 1000

⇒ Distance = 6750 metres

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
